description: Three-axis rubric for instruction-guided image edits: an environment-validity precheck, then instruction following, visual consistency, and visual quality. A pair is accepted only if every axis clears its own minimum and the equal-weight mean clears 3.5. The must-preserve list is optional on the planner's side; when it is absent the judge derives the licensed scope from the instruction alone.
environment_check: The BEFORE image contains the target object, text, or attribute the instruction refers to
The BEFORE image does not already satisfy the end state the instruction asks for
The instruction has an unambiguous, observable target that a single-image edit model can act on
The BEFORE image itself contains no structural conflict that would make the instruction undefinable

axes.description: Whether the target object, the requested change, and any exact text, numbers, counts, or relations were completed correctly and completely, and whether any unrequested change was introduced.
evidence_requirements: State explicitly whether each requirement in the instruction was met
Check text and numbers character by character or against the exact value
Point out anything unfinished, partially finished, or edited beyond the request

axes.description: Establish which object, region, and attributes were licensed to change, then check whether any non-target region, identity, structure, or semantics changed unintentionally. Use the must-preserve list when one is supplied; when it is marked as not supplied, derive the licensed scope from the instruction alone and treat everything the instruction did not license as required to stay unchanged.
evidence_requirements: State the scope that was licensed to change, and where you established it from
Check non-target objects and the background
Check identity, structure, layout, and attributes that were not requested to change

axes.description: Judge realism and naturalness: artifacts, blur, seams, melting, human anatomy, physics, lighting, shadows, reflections, and perspective, plus text rendering quality.
evidence_requirements: Point out local visual artifacts and boundary problems
Check human anatomy and physical plausibility
Check lighting, shadows, reflections, and perspective
